text: {"name": "bt_rx_hash_update", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Updates the Bluetooth receive descriptor/hash state with a tagged 32-bit word from offset 8 and a zero, clearing IRQ 321 when a negative global status and the byte at offset 12 exceed three, then returns the input context unchanged.", "subsystem": "bt", "var_renames": {"v1": "descriptor_word", "v2": "byte_field"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 4, "meaning": "word buffer or hash context field passed to hash_mix_words"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "uint32_t descriptor word mixed into the hash"}, {"offset": 12, "meaning": "uint8_t count/index/status field controlling the tag byte position"}]}
